_comment: Cards that exist only for the noncombat-only shield test (tests/unit/damage/test_prevent_noncombat_damage.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_noncombat_barricade` is Crystal Barricade's third line -- prevent all noncombat damage to OTHER creatures you control -- and `t_noncombat_absorber` is absorb 2 narrowed the same way, pinning that the flag narrows both forms of the static.

cards.name: Test Noncombat Barricade
cards.oracle_text: Prevent all noncombat damage that would be dealt to other creatures you control.

abilities.text: Prevent all noncombat damage that would be dealt to other creatures you control.

cards.name: Test Noncombat Absorber
cards.oracle_text: If a source would deal noncombat damage to this creature, prevent 2 of that damage.

abilities.text: If a source would deal noncombat damage to this creature, prevent 2 of that damage.
